## Downloads

| System | Requirements | Package |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | 12 Monterey or later, Apple Silicon and Intel | `.dmg` (universal) |
| Windows | 10 or 11, x64 | `-setup.exe` or `.msi` |
| Linux | WebKitGTK 4.1 (e.g. Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36 or later) | `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage` |

**The packages are not signed yet.** On macOS open the app the first time with right-click → *Open*. On Windows choose *More info* → *Run anyway* in SmartScreen.

More about the app: https://krocon.de/products/comiccommander/

---

Please use Comic Commander only with comics you are allowed to have – scanned from your own books, DRM-free purchases or freely licensed comics. Comic Commander does not download anything.

Bugs and ideas: https://github.com/krocon/comic-commander-tauri/issues
